targetTexts.2: “Does a wise man answer with empty counsel or fill his belly with the hot east wind?
targetTexts.3: Should he argue with useless words or speeches that serve no purpose?
targetTexts.4: But you even undermine the fear of God and hinder meditation before Him.
targetTexts.5: For your iniquity instructs your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.
targetTexts.6: Your own mouth, not mine, condemns you; your own lips testify against you.
targetTexts.7: Were you the first man ever born? Were you brought forth before the hills?
targetTexts.8: Do you listen in on the council of God or limit wisdom to yourself?
targetTexts.9: What do you know that we do not? What do you understand that is not clear to us?
targetTexts.10: Both the gray-haired and the aged are on our side—men much older than your father.
targetTexts.11: Are the consolations of God not enough for you, even words spoken gently to you?
targetTexts.12: Why has your heart carried you away, and why do your eyes flash,
targetTexts.13: so that you turn your spirit against God and pour such words from your mouth?
targetTexts.14: What is man, that he should be pure, or one born of woman, that he should be righteous?
targetTexts.15: If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
targetTexts.16: how much less man, who is vile and corrupt, who drinks injustice like water?
targetTexts.17: Listen to me and I will inform you. I will describe what I have seen,
targetTexts.18: what was declared by wise men and was not concealed from their fathers,
targetTexts.19: to whom alone the land was given when no foreigner passed among them.
targetTexts.20: A wicked man writhes in pain all his days; only a few years are reserved for the ruthless.
targetTexts.21: Sounds of terror fill his ears; in his prosperity the destroyer attacks him.
targetTexts.22: He despairs of his return from darkness; he is marked for the sword.
targetTexts.23: He wanders about as food for vultures; he knows the day of darkness is at hand.
targetTexts.24: Distress and anguish terrify him, overwhelming him like a king poised to attack.
targetTexts.25: For he has stretched out his hand against God and has vaunted himself against the Almighty,
targetTexts.26: rushing headlong at Him with a thick, studded shield.
targetTexts.27: Though his face is covered with fat and his waistline bulges with flesh,
targetTexts.28: he will dwell in ruined cities, in abandoned houses destined to become rubble.
targetTexts.29: He will no longer be rich; his wealth will not endure. His possessions will not overspread the land.
targetTexts.30: He will not escape from the darkness; the flame will wither his shoots, and the breath of God’s mouth will carry him away.
targetTexts.31: Let him not deceive himself with trust in emptiness, for emptiness will be his reward.
targetTexts.32: It will be paid in full before his time, and his branch will not flourish.
targetTexts.33: He will be like a vine stripped of its unripe grapes, like an olive tree that sheds its blossoms.
targetTexts.34: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.
targetTexts.35: They conceive trouble and give birth to evil; their womb is pregnant with deceit.”
